text:
sasha: Quick thread to align on a benchmark narrative we can use for the launch. Goal: make it operable for SRE/platform buyers and compelling for growth. High-level arc: 1) one-sentence claim (ops-friendly), 2) 2 charts (scatter cost vs latency + tail-heatmap), 3) one-page deploy cost breakdown with levers to lower unit $ (batching, quant, routing). Thoughts?

ryan: Love the ops angle. For SREs the p99 story is everything. Suggest the hero claim: "Predictable p99 latency under load, lower per-token $ at scale." Keep the hero copy short.

leah: Visuals: scatter for median vs $/1M tokens, and a small 2x2 heatmap showing tail frequency by sequence length and model variant. Also a tiny lane showing failover behavior (hosted -> dedicated -> private). I can do rough mocks.

tom: Measurement checklist: enumerate models (redwood-small/redwood-large/open-baseline), seq lens 64/256/2048, sample N=20k per cell, regional splits us-west/us-east/eu. We'll report p50/p95/p99 and 95% CI for medians. Include a reproducibility appendix. Example CSV for viz pipeline:```csv
model,seq_len,samples,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1m
redwood-hosted,64,20000,12,28,80,900
redwood-hosted,256,20000,35,90,220,1400
redwood-hosted,2048,20000,210,480,820,4600
redwood-dedicated,64,20000,9,22,60,700
redwood-dedicated,256,20000,25,70,180,1000
open-baseline,256,20000,60,150,360,2600
```

nina: Marketing + funnel notes: two hero variants — "ops-first" and "economics-first". For ops-first CTA: "See p99 under load" -> demo signup. For econ-first CTA: "Estimate your token spend" -> cost calculator lead magnet. Webinar idea: 20-minute story + 15-minute ops demo showing graceful degradation under a simulated spike.

bench-bot: run 2026-04-02T09:04:00Z completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/launch/ops-heatmap-2026-04-02.tar.gz (internal). Summary: 3 models, 3 seq lengths, 20k samples each.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging for demo env completed at 2026-04-02T10:15Z. Endpoint: https://staging.redwood.internal/demo (internal).

sasha: Nice. Next actions: (1) tom finalize CSVs + measurement appendix by EOD tomorrow (owns), (2) leah drop mock visuals + heatmap sketches by Wednesday (owns), (3) nina write two hero hooks and webinar outline (owns), (4) ryan coordinate ops demo script and failure scenarios (owns). I'll wire the content into the landing and the webinar runbook.

ryan: For the demo script, I'd like an ordered checklist: baseline load -> spike -> automatic routing to dedicated -> quantized fallback -> show metrics stream. We'll need the staging endpoints and a load harness.

leah: I'll make a small animated GIF for the routing sequence for social posts. Low-res for LinkedIn, hi-res for webinar slides.

nina: For inbound routing, propose two flows: (A) self-serve: download benchmark kit -> email capture; (B) enterprise: book demo -> form asks for SLA needs and expected QPS. We'll A/B test the landing CTAs.

tom: Adding a short note to the appendix explaining batch-size tuning and expected unit-cost deltas at 95% utilization. Also will include noise model and CI.

sasha: Great. If visuals + CSVs land by Wednesday we can freeze copy and start rehearsals. I'm assigning tasks in Notion now. Thanks everyone.
